subject: general
question: Who is the Union Minister of Power, as of January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is **Raj Kumar Singh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raj Kumar Singh** is the Union Minister of Power as of January 2023.
 
• He has been serving in this position since September 2017.
 
• He is also the Minister of New and Renewable Energy.
 
• Raj Kumar Singh is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He represents the Arrah constituency in the Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Ministry
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Ministry of Power**
 The Ministry is responsible for the development of electrical energy in India.
 
 

 **Key Functions**
 Formulating policies for power generation, transmission, and distribution.
 
 

 **Renewable Energy**
 Promoting the use of renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and hydro power.
 
 

 **Power Grid**
 Managing the national grid for efficient power distribution across the country.
 
 

 **Energy Efficiency**
 Implementing energy efficiency programs and standards to reduce energy consumption.
